svg.aria-label: Frequency spectra, phase and time–temperature superposition come from the same standard linear solid. The lower panels use teaching parameters in the 1955 WLF relation to show how temperature changes the molecular clock, then apply the corresponding frequency shifts to form a master curve. Constructed model data.
